en: Black‑and‑white historical view of a cobbled town square with people, mostly children, standing and walking in the open space. On the right is a large, two‑storey building with a clock‑tower cupola; the facade bears the signage "Hotel" and "Rathskeller." suggesting it serves as a town hall/inn. On the left, a row of attached houses and shops lines the street, one with the sign "Gustav Bierkamp." A horse‑drawn wagon stands at the far right edge. The architecture and clothing indicate an early 20th‑century Central European small town.
